Rows changed in this pass were assessed against PiSharp sources at b831158a9379e8a7f454a069ee18551c90bd7eac (with the 1.1.0.3 close-out cases in tests/PiSharp.CliParity.Tests/CloseoutCases.cs); unchanged rows keep their earlier assessedAt. The Pi entry (pisharp [options], PiArgs/PiCommand) carries the upstream CLI flags; the session verbs keep their own options. A row counts as Implemented only when an authored test case exercises it; tests are authored and registered, not executed by the refresh.

vocabulary.Implemented: PiSharp implements the surface and at least one authored test case exercises it.
vocabulary.Partial: Implemented with a narrower scope or only partly tested; see note.
vocabulary.ImplementedNoTest: Present in PiSharp sources with no authored test; not counted as implemented.
vocabulary.DifferentSurface: PiSharp offers the capability through a different native command or option; see note.

nativeStatusPolicy.unassessedRows: SDK root and module export rows are TypeScript declarations; their native C# mapping needs a reviewed mapping record, so they carry no nativeStatus and stay Deferred/Unverified.
nativeStatusPolicy.implementationEvidenceState: AuthoredTests marks rows whose nativeStatus cites authored test cases; implementationAcceptance stays Deferred until an upstream/native differential or independent acceptance exists.
